title: Specify national profile selection, including security profiles
requirements:
- Require countries to record selected profile, version, options, national extensions and applicable tests
- Cite the IHE security/privacy profile family (e.g. ATNA, IUA, XUA) alongside exchange profiles in 3.7.3
- Address version pinning, deprecation and continued availability of test artefacts
- Link to 3.6.5's call for testable vendor security claims
